QuestionStmt.S:
The Variance of the following probability distribution of X is

$$\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|}
\hline
X & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 \\
\hline
P(X) & q^3 & 3q^2p & 3qp^2 & p^3 \\
\hline
\end{array}$$

where $0 < p < 1, q = 1 - p$

Solution.S:
Step 1: The given probability distribution is exactly the binomial distribution for $n = 3$ trials with success probability $p$.

Step 2: For a binomial distribution, the variance is given by:

$$\text{Var}(X) = n p q = 3 p q$$

Step 3: Therefore, the variance is $3pq$.

Final Answer: $$\boxed{3pq}$$

Hence, the correct option is B.
